story: I grew up in Nashik, Maharashtra. After school I took the diploma route into computer engineering, then did my BE through lateral entry. My first job was writing web content for a digital marketing company, which taught me a lot about clear writing.

In March 2020 I joined Winjit Technologies (part of RIB Group) as an intern. Over six years I worked my way up to Project Engineer and Team Lead. Most of my work has been in fintech: loan origination, credit decisions and reading bank statements automatically.

A lot of that work was changing systems that were already live. New banks, new lenders and new rules kept coming, and the software had to keep up without breaking. That is a big reason I chose the MSc in Software Engineering at the University of Limerick, and why CS5709 Software Engineering Evolution feels so relevant.
I use AI tools like GitHub Copilot, Gemini and Claude in my daily work to speed up routine coding, so I can spend more time on design and reviews.
